name: PORTERS Corporation
summary: PORTERS Corporation, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and formed in 2001, develops cloud-based human resources solutions in Japan. Its main product, PORTERS, is a cloud service for HR matching used by firms such as staffing companies, recruitment agencies and similar providers. The company also offers support services such as data migration and screen operations, with features including customization, media collaboration, form creation and reporting dashboards.
